title: Decode a dense quadratic defect through an acquired Frobenius-band code
statement: Precompose L(X)=sum_a=-s..s ca X^(2^a) with Frobenius^s to obtain a dimension2s+1 Gabidulin code. For global polar-rank error r with2r<=d-2s-1, left-annihilator interpolation uniquely recovers every compatible block.

requires: Acquired centroid field, trace Gram coordinates, s>=1 and2s<d
Actual alternating polar defect rank, not symmetric-completion rank
provides: Precompose L(X)=sum_a=-s..s ca X^(2^a) with Frobenius^s to obtain a dimension2s+1 Gabidulin code. For global polar-rank error r with2r<=d-2s-1, left-annihilator interpolation uniquely recovers every compatible block.
assumptions: Diagonal trace refinements need a binary linear correction
costs: Polynomial-time block decoding; ordinary recovered degree2^s+1 remains charged
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: Unknown dense low-rank noise need not be supplied or guessed by support.
